lines: The Composer autoloader is optimized beyond level 1. The manual allows only config.optimize-autoloader: an authoritative class map breaks the upgrade of the app, and APCu is no required extension.
72 classes in lib/ whose name does not follow PSR-4 below OCA\TwoFactorGateway, the namespace the server derives from <namespace> of info.xml. The loader of the server does not find such a class.
1 use of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

2 timed jobs do not say whether they are time sensitive. A job that sets TIME_INSENSITIVE with setTimeSensitivity() is moved to the maintenance window of the server; whether a job is heavy enough for that only its maintainer knows.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 8 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 63 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
